# quality

> One fast, predictable code-quality workflow for Rust, Swift, Android/Kotlin, JavaScript, TypeScript, Astro, content, and GitHub Actions repositories.

quality is a deterministic local CLI. It detects and runs established ecosystem analyzers; its checking path does not call an AI service.

## Documentation

- [Overview](https://quality-cli.santi020k.chatgpt.site/overview/): Purpose, principles, and supported workflows.
- [Getting started](https://quality-cli.santi020k.chatgpt.site/getting-started/): Install, initialize, diagnose, and run the first check.
- [Commands](https://quality-cli.santi020k.chatgpt.site/commands/): Complete CLI command reference.
- [Configuration](https://quality-cli.santi020k.chatgpt.site/configuration/): Configure built-in adapters, repository tasks, and custom tools.
- [Changed files and baselines](https://quality-cli.santi020k.chatgpt.site/changed-files-and-baselines/): Fast local feedback and incremental adoption.
- [GitHub Actions](https://quality-cli.santi020k.chatgpt.site/github-actions/): Annotations, summaries, and SARIF in CI.
- [AI coding agents](https://quality-cli.santi020k.chatgpt.site/ai-agents/): Repository instructions and structured-output workflow for agents.
- [Built-in and custom adapters](https://quality-cli.santi020k.chatgpt.site/adapters/): Supported analyzers and extension points.
- [quality.yml JSON Schema](https://quality-cli.santi020k.chatgpt.site/quality.schema.json): Machine-readable configuration schema.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/santi020k/quality): Source, releases, contributing guidance, and security policy.
